name: Escape Pod Bay
narrativeOnEnter: A single escape pod — standard crew evacuation vehicle, rated for four. The launch panel is active. A keypad requires the authorisation code before the pod will launch. Through the blast window: open space, stars, the distant glow of Earth.

hotspots.label: Escape Pod — Launch Panel
hotspots.lockedMessage: Launch sequence locked. Enter the authorisation code on the keypad.

action.text:
ESCAPE POD — MERIDIAN ALPHA — STATUS

Fuel: 100%
Life support: NOMINAL (14 hours)
Capacity: 4 persons
Current occupancy: 0

Launch authorisation code required.
Code is tied to crew manifest numbers.
See crew personnel files for reference.

POD TRAJECTORY: Automatic — Earth orbit intercept, 6.2 hours.

Through the blast-proof glass: open space. The Earth hangs in the lower quadrant — blue and enormous. The rescue shuttle is not visible from this angle.

A small plaque is mounted below the window:

'MERIDIAN STATION ALPHA
Constructed: Year 1, Station Era
Designed to last: 25 years

For the crew who gave it life.'
